# Stop

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Runtime](BlitzBasic-Runtime)

```blitzbasic
Stop
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

In the original this paused the program in the debugger so that you could look at its variables, and ran on when you continued.

**Differences and known gaps:**

* Only a build made with the debug option (`-d`) stops: it is a breakpoint for a debugger, and ends the program with a signal when none is attached. In any other build `Stop` does nothing. See [Differences](Differences#stop).
